summary: Floating stairs lack handrails and the transparent balustrade creates fall and collision risks.

hazards.title: Staircase Missing Handrail
hazards.detail: Open staircase lacks a continuous handrail on the wall or outer edge.
fixSteps: Install a secure continuous handrail along the stair path.
Ensure handrail height conforms to local residential building code.

hazards.title: Low-Visibility Glass Balustrade
hazards.detail: Glass railing on upper and lower stairs presents impact and fall hazards.
fixSteps: Apply frosted vision strips or decals to make glass clearly visible.
Ensure mounting hardware and panels can withstand full body weight.

hazards.title: Raised Texture Rug Edge
hazards.detail: Scalloped patterned area rug edge is prone to catching feet.
fixSteps: Place a non-skid rug pad underneath the entire carpet area.
Use rug tape to secure uneven outer perimeter edges flat.
